Composite FrodoKEM AuthEnvelopedData Example

This example follows draft-song-lamps-cms-composite-frodokem-02 and
draft-song-lamps-pq-composite-frodokem-02. Alice encrypts the content
"Hello, world!" for Bob, whose certificate carries an
id-FrodoKEM976-SHAKE-X25519-SHA3-256 public key.

  Composite KEM:        id-FrodoKEM976-SHAKE-X25519-SHA3-256
                        (TBD2; prototype OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.22554.5.12.2)
  rid:                  subjectKeyIdentifier
  KDF:                  id-alg-hkdf-with-sha256, salt ""
  ukm:                  absent
  Key wrap:             id-aes256-wrap, kekLength 32
  Content encryption:   id-aes256-GCM, 12-byte nonce, 16-byte tag,
                        no authenticated attributes
  Content type:         id-data

Values are in hex and lengths in bytes.

Fixed Inputs

Every random input is fixed, so that the example can be reproduced. Each
one is the first L bytes of SHAKE256("Composite FrodoKEM CMS example: "
|| name), where name is the ASCII string in quotes below.

"s" (24), FrodoKEM KeyGen s (Bob):
  2ba64b904de67eefa18f9a8b3b96560cc95796cf02bfa800

"seedSE" (48), FrodoKEM KeyGen seedSE (Bob):
  c0f5702a60d8779f3eb4c66637563d864c79f885d2211cdbfb9e717c967480e3
  6bfdba5612eea3e2060a75312aab51aa

"z" (16), FrodoKEM KeyGen z (Bob):
  3b3bb24252ca8d544b489b050fe34e5d

"X25519 private key" (32), Bob's X25519 private key:
  86407feedd6781b64c5b8d5642ce1319428510fe3900de5a4dd5c638cfb6c761

"u" (24), FrodoKEM Encaps u (Alice):
  b70b68fe606db8d1cd3831a5bce81236519b10357d864df5

"salt" (48), FrodoKEM Encaps salt (Alice):
  6a119a492f59b5339781f7de909baca0abe504af334ccb3ca9faf68ded2b2c85
  4393fe1197c9074d037cc9d52b6e7289

"X25519 ephemeral private key" (32), Alice's ephemeral X25519 private
key:
  e8f9a9b681a36369fa64546d9eb06efb8256064296e6d8831641a1143ddfc6fd

"CEK" (32), the content-authenticated-encryption key:
  ef94599d89be8a1a40fa20e5964082c6d84e714cfa6404de8ef411b6a00a4df2

"GCM nonce" (12), the AES-GCM nonce:
  78905f5481de758568a52af0

"CA ML-DSA-65 seed" (32), the seed of the CA's ML-DSA-65 key:
  45ee1c3f49abf6290d0b3f9b57451eb4e459705337dffc356c9e5608c7670f28

The ML-DSA-65 signatures on the two certificates are hedged, so they
differ from one run of the generator to the next. Every other value
below follows from the fixed inputs.

Bob's composite key pair comes from KeyGen (Section 3.1 of
draft-song-lamps-pq-composite-frodokem-02): FrodoKEM KeyGen from s,
seedSE and z, and the X25519 public key from the X25519 private key.
trad_sk is the raw 32-byte X25519 private key of RFC 7748.

B.1. Originator CMS Processing

Alice obtains Bob's composite public key, ek = frodo_pk || trad_pk, from
his certificate, which is given at the end.

Alice runs Encaps (Section 3.2 of
draft-song-lamps-pq-composite-frodokem-02) with the fixed u, salt and
ephemeral X25519 private key. The inputs to the KEM combiner are:

frodo_ss (24):
  918d69dd4ab1e2cbc3c0f40baca9fb5b450ec2fdcee9520b

trad_ss (32):
  bc10838140169837b4d1a6867a5ac00cc26c33641304361bf4166a8b7176ee08

trad_ct, Alice's ephemeral X25519 public key (32):
  02f3a1e253128c99c7f7f7352c722cb326c6cfc6bb7fcdb6679fdd4b2fc33b35

trad_pk, Bob's X25519 public key (32):
  4c3736372c5a844baf80a1f6926430c6e01dfbf893701662dcfdab361b0c5973

Label, "FrodoKEM976-SHAKE-X25519" (24):
  46726f646f4b454d3937362d5348414b452d583235353139

The composite shared secret, ss = SHA3-256(frodo_ss || trad_ss ||
trad_ct || trad_pk || Label) (32):
  5871fb07bad7db0ae0d14143ee737ca442d41e234550ad7b34b7810bd36e0243

becomes kemct:

Alice encodes the CMSORIforKEMOtherInfo (Section 5 of RFC 9629), the
info input of the KDF. It holds the wrap algorithm and kekLength, and no
ukm (18):
  3010300b060960864801650304012d020120

  SEQUENCE
    SEQUENCE
      OBJECT IDENTIFIER 2.16.840.1.101.3.4.1.45  -- id-aes256-wrap
    INTEGER 32

Alice derives the KEK with HKDF-SHA256, salt "", IKM ss, the info above
and L 32 (Section 2.2.1 of draft-song-lamps-cms-composite-frodokem-02).
KEK (32):
  592ca8196d496e7d69a987d9d9c7d310b380cdf6a5545c669a4d717bb7be9720

Alice uses the fixed CEK (32):
  ef94599d89be8a1a40fa20e5964082c6d84e714cfa6404de8ef411b6a00a4df2

Alice wraps the CEK under the KEK with AES-Wrap-256 (RFC 3394).
encryptedKey (40):
  d5ebccee52dc1cdad2a64719c7222a1760741a5f93e682ddab7260641463e79d
  354208d69109584c

Alice encrypts the content with AES-256-GCM under the CEK, with the
fixed nonce and no additional authenticated data.

content, "Hello, world!" (13):
  48656c6c6f2c20776f726c6421

nonce (12):
  78905f5481de758568a52af0

encryptedContent (13):
  68ed1204cef42514565eaa4092

mac, the GCM authentication tag (16):
  43a8725b67201c7ea840d67ee4075656

Alice puts these values in an AuthEnvelopedData (RFC 5083) with one
KEMRecipientInfo (RFC 9629), inside a ContentInfo. The message is given
in PEM at the end. Its structure, with each OCTET STRING over 64 bytes
shown by its length only, is:

  SEQUENCE
    OBJECT IDENTIFIER 1.2.840.113549.1.9.16.1.23
      -- id-ct-authEnvelopedData
    [0]
      SEQUENCE
        INTEGER 0
        SET
          [4]
            OBJECT IDENTIFIER 1.2.840.113549.1.9.16.13.3  -- id-ori-kem
            SEQUENCE
              INTEGER 0
              [0] (20 bytes)
                28dc83ecdd10b0938e90f2673cedbfc2707f9924
              SEQUENCE
                OBJECT IDENTIFIER 1.3.6.1.4.1.22554.5.12.2
                  -- id-FrodoKEM976-SHAKE-X25519-SHA3-256
              OCTET STRING (15824 bytes)
              SEQUENCE
                OBJECT IDENTIFIER 1.2.840.113549.1.9.16.3.28
                  -- id-alg-hkdf-with-sha256

              SEQUENCE
                OBJECT IDENTIFIER 2.16.840.1.101.3.4.1.45
                  -- id-aes256-wrap
              OCTET STRING (40 bytes)
                d5ebccee52dc1cdad2a64719c7222a1760741a5f93e682ddab726064
                1463e79d354208d69109584c

            SEQUENCE
              OCTET STRING (12 bytes)
                78905f5481de758568a52af0

        OCTET STRING (16 bytes)

B.2. Recipient CMS Processing

Bob finds the KEMRecipientInfo whose rid matches the
subjectKeyIdentifier of his certificate (20):
  28dc83ecdd10b0938e90f2673cedbfc2707f9924

Bob runs Decaps (Section 3.3 of
draft-song-lamps-pq-composite-frodokem-02) on kemct with his private
key, which is given at the end. He derives trad_pk from his X25519
private key.

frodo_ss (24):
  918d69dd4ab1e2cbc3c0f40baca9fb5b450ec2fdcee9520b

trad_ss (32):
  bc10838140169837b4d1a6867a5ac00cc26c33641304361bf4166a8b7176ee08

ss (32):
  5871fb07bad7db0ae0d14143ee737ca442d41e234550ad7b34b7810bd36e0243

Bob derives the KEK from ss and the CMSORIforKEMOtherInfo, which he
encodes from the KEMRecipientInfo fields. KEK (32):
  592ca8196d496e7d69a987d9d9c7d310b380cdf6a5545c669a4d717bb7be9720

Bob unwraps encryptedKey with the KEK. CEK (32):
  ef94599d89be8a1a40fa20e5964082c6d84e714cfa6404de8ef411b6a00a4df2

Bob decrypts encryptedContent with the CEK and checks the mac. content,
"Hello, world!" (13):
  48656c6c6f2c20776f726c6421

Bob's Certificate

Issued by the CA below. Its SubjectPublicKeyInfo holds ek, and its
subjectKeyIdentifier is the SHA-1 hash of ek (RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.2,
method 1).
